Your Google Business Profile is often the first thing a local customer sees.

A 10-minute check:
1. Open your profile on Google Maps.
2. Confirm your hours, phone number and website are current.
3. Pick the primary category that matches what you sell most.

Small details here decide whether you show up for "near me" searches.
